value.title: Hotel Videseter | hotel in stryn | Gamle Strynefjellsveg 150, Hjelledalen, Norway
value.description: Experience the beauty of Stryn from Hotel Videseter,  located 575 masl. We are located at the edge of the majestic mountains in Hjelle valley, where you can enjoy the view and enjoy stunning sunsets from your bedroom. The great waterfall Videfossen and scenic road Gamle Strynefjellsveg  is right next door to the hotel.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Our Location
Welcome to Hotel Videseter, where the breathtaking beauty of Stryn surrounds you. Nestled at 576 masl at the edge of the majestic mountains of Hjelle Valley, our hotel offers stunning views all summer long. Relax to the sound of the impressive Videfossen waterfall or embark on an unforgettable journey along the curves of the National Tourist Road Gamle Strynefjellsveg.
Hotel Videseter is perfect for any active traveler with Stryn Summer Ski centre, the Oppstryn lake and endless hiking possibilities nearby. Our location is also very convenient for popular daytrips by car, ie. Geiranger-Hellesylt, Dalsnibba viewpoint and the Briksdal Glacier.
Our dedicated team is committed to providing you with an exceptional, ensuring you feel right at home during your stay.
UNESCO Heritage site: Geirangerfjord
The hotel is situated in close proximity to the renowned UNESCO World Heritage site, Geirangerfjord. This spectacular fjord is distinguished by its awe-inspiring landscapes, characterized by towering mountains, verdant, and magnificent waterfalls. Guests can partake in a range of outdoor activities, including hiking and boat excursions, while appreciating the tranquil beauty of the area. Geirangerfjord is an essential destination for those seeking both adventure and serenity in nature.
Downhill skiing in summer?!
Stryn Summer Ski centre
Discover the thrill of summer skiing only 10 minutes away from our hotel at the summer ski centre! Enjoy an action-packed day on the slopes, then unwind on our hotel rooftop terrace or treat yourself to a refreshing sauna session after. The ski centre typically opens at the end of May and remains open as long as there’s snow. Make your summer adventure unforgettable with us! For more information please see their website: https://strynsommerski.com/

Do you have a special event on the horizon?
We're here to help!
Every event is unique and requires a personalized approach. Our skilled team collaborates closely with clients to bring their vision to reality. We welcome both corporate and private events to our outstanding venue for an unforgettable experience. Please feel free to reach for more information.
Work at Videseter
Every spring we look for motivated candidates to be part of our amazing team. We are a seasonal hotel open from May-September
